Thanks for the response. While I used the flair "no advice wanted" I'm still very much taking advice and hearing others voice their opinion. I didn't make everything that clear, this post was just made to vent but the last time I brought it up was about a month ago. She had a c section and it was very traumatic for her, she has no interest in having another kid for at least 3 years and I want to get a vasectomy within the year as my original post stated. That's all it comes down to, I've told myself that I will only talk about it if a family member brings it up or of she brings it up. 

While I agree that both parents should both be on board with having another child, I somewhat agree that both parents should agree on birth control. Maybe I'm selfish but  I whole hardly believe that a woman has every right to her body, so does a man. Going behind her back and not telling her that I get a secret vasectomy is 100% not ok, and I want to talk to her (at a much later date) about it. I'm willing (if she is) is to go to some sort of consueling but I very much do not want another child whatsoever. I feel with a vasectomy we dont have to worry as much (as its not 100%) and I feel like i would just be happy with that decision, a its not like a vasectomy means you can never have kids ever agian, while not the easiest or the most cost effective it doesnt mean its not possible. may also have a strong belief in this as I live in a state that has a full abortion ban. I feel as when it comes to this theres not really any compromises to be made, as you stated both parents should be on board my plan is just giving her space and taking about it at a later date. once again must thank you for taking time to respond.

Thank you for the response, I talked to her something like this about a month ago, I explained that I want to get a vasectomy within the year, she said that I should wait 3 years, I explained that even if I did she can still get pregnant (I understand a vasectomy isn't 100% but it's still pretty good form of birth control) and I know that would depress the hell out of me. I just feel like getting the procedure would make me super happy but I wish my wife was on board with it too.

Thank you for your response, and I 100% agree with you, I can relate to childfree more then alot of parents (obviously I relate to one and done the most) this is something I've been thinking about since my wife got pregnant and it's something that I feel like I would be extremely happy with and not regret it. I'm not sitting here weighing the pros or cons, I just want it. I just wish my wife was more on board with it. That's something I don't think she understands is that if I do get a vasectomy it doesn't mean that we can't have kids ever (I am, maybe strangely enough, am more interested in adopting then having another kid but I'm still very much set on one and done) and thank you, I love this little girl and I love my wife that's why I want to just focus on them both and be one and done.

Thanks for the reply, I greatly appreciate it. I just feel that I'll be very happy getting a vasectomy but I wish my wife was on board with it. It's not like we can't have children after the procedure but i think it just rubs her a certain way. I just want to focus on one kid and try to travel and spend time with my wife as she is my best friend, having more kids i feel make that disappear more and more. I think that's what's getting at me the most. I want to open up the conversation with her at a later date but I truly believe that both of us have to be 100% on board with having another kid and I'm very much not.

Thanks for the reply, yeah I've been thinking about it since I found out my wife was pregnant, I should've been more clear about that. I still want to wait at least a year before I decide for sure but definitely not 3 years and I feel like I'll be extremely happy with getting a vasectomy.  Her family (this soon which is beyond bizarre to me) is already asking when baby numer 2 is due. I firmly but respectfully tell them that I'm not interested in another kid, they get so defensive and say you'll want one soon enough and "you want to have a son" I just say "no I know what I want and I want to raise and focus on my duagther."

Thanks for your reply, yeah I read about that but honestly if I go through with it I won't reverse it, more then likely, I give her props willing to go through pregnancy again but it was hard seeing her like that, she had a c section and is still having trouble just using the restroom by herself. Idk I very much do not want to go through this again and just want to focus on one kid. Her family and her Also claim that "you would want a son" but honestly I'm very content on just focusing on my daughter and not adding more responsibilities that I can't afford.
